preconditions.theorem: If MOVE_LEER is passed to the installed DoMoveAnim entry and the named environment contracts hold, this finite execution consumes the hit as a complete BL plus LDR instruction window.
preconditions.boundary: A valid synchronous single battle interface, not a proof that a particular save, gamepad input, or all plays reaches the entry.
preconditions.resources: empty tile/palette tag registries; first free tile0 and palette0; reserved palette count0; nonalias allocation success for2560 and32 bytes
preconditions.battle_graphics_context: valid, readable, nonalias battlerData/healthboxData pointers; transformed species1; no Illusion; these are incoming battle-interface conditions
preconditions.gpu: VCOUNT0 and DISPCNT0; empty deferred GPU queue; hardware VBlank/DMA does not run during the interpreted intervals
preconditions.scheduler: one invocation of the registered animation callback per displayed wait step; no unmodeled interleaving mutates the proof projection; no task runs between monbg allocation and the synchronous createsprite callback
preconditions.undefined_values: r12 becomes an unusable unknown at every external boundary; MUL carry becomes unknown until a defining instruction; dependent execution is rejected
preconditions.external_helpers: ABI return with callee-saved registers/SP/return context preserved; permitted unrelated display/audio/heap effects are abstracted; control, cursor, resource tags, selected slot and the explicitly supplied nonalias battle input projection remain as required by each contract
preconditions.scope: one concrete bounded witness under the interface conditions; neither arbitrary RAM nor arbitrary incoming registers

AllocZeroed_success_nonalias.requires: success,2560 or32 bytes, no concurrent live allocation, nonalias scratch and stack/control/sprite/tag regions
AllocZeroed_success_nonalias.ensures: returns zeroed SCRATCH, caller-saved registers/flags need not survive

Free_matching_allocation.ensures: normal return, no writes to control/registry/sprite projection

valid_illusion_party_return_frame.requires: battler0..3 and valid single-battle party indexes
valid_illusion_party_return_frame.ensures: nonalias player/enemy first-mon pointer with species1

valid_mon_field_read_return_frame.ensures: species1 or HP1; preserves animation/sprite/resource projection

visible_battler_priorities_return_frame.ensures: normal return; permitted OAM priority effects do not alias cursor/callback/tags or future free slot2

healthbox_priorities_return_frame.ensures: normal return; permitted healthbox OAM effects do not alias the selected sprite or animation inputs

bounded_bg_dma_request_return_frame.ensures: normal return; queued DMA writes remain in these background VRAM spans; no transfer is executed in the model

bounded_battler_graphics_copy_return_fra.requires: battler position0, bg2,palette9; nonalias tiles0x02013000/map0x02014800 and tilesOffset768
bounded_battler_graphics_copy_return_fra.ensures: normal return; graphics writes/queued transfers do not alias animation cursor/callback, sprite slot2, resource tags, or battle pointers

song_start_return_audio_frame.requires: actual SE185 from the selected command; valid initialized audio state
song_start_return_audio_frame.ensures: normal return; audio-only effects disjoint from proof projection; no audio IRQ interpreted

audio_resume_return_audio_frame.requires: actual SE1 or SE2 player pointer
audio_resume_return_audio_frame.ensures: normal return with disjoint audio-only effects

audio_pan_return_audio_frame.ensures: normal return with disjoint audio-only effects

BIOS_LZ10_bounded_semantics.requires: SWI11/BX LR; finite valid LZ10 payload and matching allocated destination
BIOS_LZ10_bounded_semantics.ensures: exact decoded bytes written only inside matching allocation; full encoded identity retained, no payload published

BIOS_CpuSet_bounded_semantics.requires: SWI0B/BX LR; bounded positive count, valid aligned source/destination and fill/copy mode
BIOS_CpuSet_bounded_semantics.ensures: exact bounded write; destination is checked by the common write allowlist
